The measurements cover depths ranging from 0 to 0.275 meters, with 210Pb concentrations spanning from 0 to 147.1 Bq/kg and 137Cs concentrations up to 19.8 Bq/kg. This data can be utilized for dating sediment layers, studying sediment accumulation rates, and understanding environmental changes over time. The dataset was collected on April 8, 2022.
